newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore's rulers win all but two assembly seats.
newsitem.headline: Singapore's rulers win all but two assembly seats.

text.p: Singapore's long-ruling People's Action Party (PAP) took all but two seats in the country's 83-member parliament in general elections on Friday, according to official results.

The PAP wrapped up its landslide, guaranteed before a vote was cast when opposition parties contested only 36 seats, with a close win in a five-member, winner-take-all battle in the Cheng San constituency.
Prime Minister Goh Chock Tong had laid his prestige on the line to beat the left-leaning Workers' Party in Cheng San, saying defeat there would suggest his position had weakened at home and abroad.
The opposition had held four seats in the outgoing parliament. The only opposition winners were from the Workers' Party and the Singapore People's Party.
